auth.sessionExpiredBody: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue. Protected data from the previous session is no longer available.
auth.loginBody: Healthcare Web uses your organization identity provider. Username and password are not collected in this application.
auth.oidcMissing: The identity provider is not configured for this environment. Set VITE_OIDC_ISSUER and VITE_OIDC_CLIENT_ID.
auth.callbackError: Sign-in could not be completed. Try again.

org.selectBody: Choose the healthcare organization for this tab. Another tab can use a different organization.
org.unassignedBody: Your account is provisioned, but you are not assigned to a healthcare organization. This application is not Platform Admin.

facility.label: Work facility
facility.requiredBody: Your access in this organization is limited to specific facilities. Choose a work facility before continuing. This is not a chart filter.
facility.allInOrganizationHint: You may work across accessible facilities in this organization. A work facility is optional and does not filter the future clinical chart.

workspace.homeBody: Select a workspace from the navigation. Patient lookup is available when you have identity-read permission. Open Chart from Clinical after selecting a patient.
workspace.empty: This workspace is not implemented yet. No patient or clinical data is shown.
workspace.noWorkspaces: No workspaces are available for your permissions in this organization.

errors.forbiddenBody: You cannot open this area with your current organization permissions. The server remains the authority.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again later.

patient.selectBody: Search by exact medical record number, NIK, BPJS number, or patient identity. Confirm the person before continuing. This does not open a clinical chart.
patient.lookupForbidden: You do not have permission to look up patients in this organization.
patient.chooseWorkflow: Choose the workspace workflow for this lookup. Purpose follows that workspace and does not grant extra permission.
patient.noWorkflow: No approved lookup workflow is available for your permissions.
patient.confirmPrompt: Confirm this is the correct patient before selecting.
patient.noMatchBody: No patient was selected. This does not create a new registration.
patient.ambiguous: More than one patient matched. Do not select from this screen.
patient.ambiguousBody: Send this case to identity review. Generic lookup cannot merge or choose for you.
patient.reviewRequired: This identifier needs identity review before clinical selection.
patient.reviewRequiredBody: The national identifier is not verified for deterministic selection.
patient.invalidLookup: The lookup value is not valid for the selected identifier type.
patient.selected: Patient selected for this organization session.
patient.name: Name

chart.title: Clinical chart
chart.selectPatientFirst: Select a patient before opening the clinical chart. No clinical record is loaded yet.
chart.identityUpdated: This record was updated to the current canonical patient identity.
chart.summaryEmpty: No items in this summary overview.
chart.summaryOmitted: This overview does not include this list. Open the section when it is available.
chart.sectionEmpty: No documented records in this section.
chart.timelineEmpty: No timeline events in this page.
chart.unavailable: This information is not available with your current permissions.
chart.sectionError: This section could not be loaded.
chart.shellError: The clinical chart could not be opened.
chart.notFound: This patient record is not available.
chart.retired: This patient record is no longer available for clinical access.
chart.cursorError: Timeline paging could not continue. Try opening the timeline again.
chart.notesMetadataOnly: Note titles and metadata only. Note body is not shown.

note.formHint: Notes must be linked to an encounter for the selected patient. Text is stored as written.
note.finalizeBody: Signing finalizes this note. It cannot be edited afterwards.
note.author: Author
note.finalConfirmation: This note is final and cannot be edited in this session.
note.unsavedBody: Unsaved note text will be discarded. It is not stored in the browser.
note.versionConflict: This draft changed. Stop and start a new note. This session will not merge text.
note.notDraft: This note is no longer a draft.
note.idempotencyConflict: This save key was already used for a different request.
note.facilityMismatch: Work facility does not match this encounter or note.
note.identityNotUsable: This patient identity cannot receive clinical notes.
note.notFound: The encounter or note is not available.
note.forbidden: You no longer have access to save this note.
note.noEncounters: No encounters are available for this patient.
note.validation: The note could not be saved with the current values.
note.saveFailed: The note could not be saved.
note.abortNotRollback: The browser stopped waiting. That does not mean the server cancelled the save.

manualVitals.title: Record manual vital sign
manualVitals.forbidden: Manual vital signs are not available.
manualVitals.notFound: The encounter or patient is not available.
manualVitals.validation: The measurement could not be saved with the current values.
manualVitals.saveFailed: The measurement could not be saved.
manualVitals.idempotencyConflict: This save key was already used for a different request.
manualVitals.abortNotRollback: The browser stopped waiting. That does not mean the server cancelled the save.
